limitations: One large related pedigree; not five independent families.
Patient ages/death dates conflict internally; TableS2 birth/deathmonths versus listedyears, Fig1P1death3.2vsTableS2 2.9; Patient3 biopsyage2.9 conflicts with listeddeath2.5.
MainText says FAR2 segregates withPatient2 but S2actuallyshows affectedPatient2WT, supporting nonsegregation; do not repeat erroneous wording.
Graphicalsummary says ataxia, whereas Table1 gives0/5 andTableS2No/NA.
MainTable1 microcephaly4/5,shortstature5/5 exceed complete individual measurements (P2NA;P1OFC−1.89SD).
Workbook mainfigures use numbering offset by1; S3B control rows contain exact repeated values, so independent-control sample count not inferred.
Proteasomal inhibition/HRD1loss raises mutant abundance with aggregation; this is not functional rescue or BubR1 evidence.
